blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuanos should limit their exposure to the afternoon heat as the heat index could reach 40 degrees Celsius (°C) on Wednesday, Nov. 18. The weather bureau warns of heat cramps, exhaustion, and potentially life-threatening heat stroke.
